explanation: EXCLURAD computation completed for η electroproduction at the requested kinematics with CLAS12 standard settings (model=3/EtaMAID-2023, rc_mode=0/full O(α), bmom=6.53 GeV, ivec=1/proton, vcut=0.166 GeV²). The kinematic point W=1.54 GeV is physically allowed (above η production threshold at 1.486 GeV) but only 54 MeV above threshold. Sigma_Born (the unpolarized Born cross section, output column in radtot.dat) = 0.0008651649 barns was successfully computed. However, delta (the radiative correction factor δ = σ_obs/σ₀) returned NaN due to numerical issues in the hadronic model table evaluation near threshold. The EtaMAID-2023 multipole amplitudes (especially the S1+ wave amplitude at tai:2) evaluate to NaN at this extreme kinematic point. This is a known limitation documented in the README: 'For runs near the η threshold or large |cos θ*|, use the unphysical-skip runner instead.' While kinematically valid, this point is too close to threshold for numerically stable radiative correction calculations.
